styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.DALSOE: a sturdy young potter with a kind round face in clay-stained white hemp clothes, a gray headband and straw sandals
characters.HWANG: a sly thin supervisor with a thin mustache in a dark green official robe and black gat
characters.JEONG: a dignified white-bearded high official in a crimson robe and black gat
characters.TEACHER: a frail old potter with a white topknot and white beard in clay-stained white clothes
characters.EOKSUN: a little village girl with two short pigtails in a patched pink jeogori and straw sandals

scenes.S01: Full moon night at a Joseon royal kiln yard: rows of perfectly symmetrical white porcelain jars look cold and gray, while one large round white moon jar in the center glows softly and warmly like the moon itself. Bright, readable moonlight. No people, nothing written.
scenes.S02: [WEB] Scene at a royal kiln yard under a full moon, two clear roles: 1. LEFT, standing calmly beside a large round white moon jar: DALSOE. 2. RIGHT, on his knees with head bowed to the ground: HWANG, his official robe dusty. The humble potter is the dignified one.
scenes.S05: A Joseon royal porcelain kiln village on a hillside: a long stepped climbing kiln with smoke rising, stacks of firewood, rows of white jars drying in the sun, pine-covered mountains. No people.
scenes.S06: Only one person in the picture: DALSOE sitting at a wooden potter's wheel, shaping a large white clay jar with both hands, smiling gently, clay on his forearms.
scenes.S07: Exactly two people: the old potter TEACHER kneading a lump of clay and smiling, teaching DALSOE who watches closely beside him in a workshop.
scenes.S08: Only one person in the picture: HWANG holding up a small perfect white porcelain bowl, inspecting it with narrowed eyes and a smug face, a long stick in his other hand.
scenes.S09: Close-up of DALSOE's big clay-covered hands carefully joining two large white clay bowls rim to rim, one upside down on top of the other, to form one big round jar on a wooden table.
scenes.S10: A large round white porcelain moon jar just taken out of a kiln, sitting on a plain wooden plank, very slightly lopsided and asymmetrical, soft milky white glaze with a completely plain undecorated surface. Plain empty paper background. No people, no letters, no calligraphy anywhere.
scenes.S11: [WEB] Scene in a kiln workshop yard, two clear roles: 1. LEFT: HWANG raising a long stick and shouting, pointing at a large round white moon jar. 2. RIGHT: DALSOE standing in front of the jar with arms spread, protecting it.
scenes.S12: Only one person in the picture: the old potter TEACHER at dusk behind a kiln, quietly covering a large round white jar with a straw mat to hide it, looking around cautiously.
scenes.S14: Only one person in the picture: DALSOE walking away from a kiln village on a windy gray day, carrying one large round WHITE porcelain jar wrapped in straw rope on his back, head down, thatched huts behind him.
scenes.S15: [SIL] Sunset over a winding mountain path, a lone man walking with a large round jar tied on his back, small thatched village far away below.
scenes.S16: Poor Joseon villagers in patched clothes gather curiously around a large round white jar set down in front of a thatched hut, DALSOE smiling shyly beside it.
scenes.S17: Only one person in the picture: EOKSUN hugging a big round white jar with both arms, cheek pressed against it, laughing happily, in front of a thatched hut and a stone wall. No letters, no calligraphy anywhere.
scenes.S18: [SIL] Gray dusk sky over dry cracked rice fields and a quiet thatched village with no chimney smoke, bare trees as black silhouettes.
scenes.S19: Villagers line up and each pour a small handful of grain into one single large round white jar in the middle of a thatched village yard, DALSOE holding a wooden scoop beside it. Only one jar in the picture.
scenes.S20: Exactly two people: DALSOE scooping grain from a large round white jar into a small gourd bowl held by EOKSUN, both smiling.
scenes.S21: Warm evening in a thatched village yard: villagers sitting together around a large round white jar, sharing simple meals from bowls, children laughing.
scenes.S23: Exactly two people at a kiln yard: JEONG in a crimson official robe delivering orders with a stern face, and HWANG bowing low before him.
scenes.S24: Several large white porcelain jars sagging and slumped out of shape in front of a kiln, their round bodies caved in and collapsed like melted dough, big cracks, broken shards on the ground. No people, nothing written.
scenes.S25: Only one person in the picture: HWANG pacing in a kiln yard, clutching his head with both hands in panic, sagging collapsed white porcelain jars and broken shards behind him.
scenes.S26: [SIL] Sunset, a group of officials and servants on horseback and on foot riding toward a small thatched village along a dirt road.
scenes.S27: [WEB] Scene in a thatched village yard, three clear roles: 1. CENTER: two servants lifting a large round white jar with ropes. 2. LEFT: HWANG pointing and smirking. 3. RIGHT: EOKSUN crying and pulling at a servant's sleeve, villagers behind her upset.
scenes.S28: Only one person in the picture: HWANG at night in a small room lit by an oil lamp, stroking a large round white jar with a greedy grin, plain paper sliding doors behind him. No letters, no calligraphy anywhere.
scenes.S30: Full moon night at a royal kiln yard decorated with lanterns, officials in robes standing in rows, a low wooden platform in the center. Bright moonlight keeps the scene readable.
scenes.S31: Exactly two people at a moonlit kiln yard with lanterns: HWANG standing beside a large round white moon jar on a low wooden platform, proudly presenting it with an open palm and a smug grin, and JEONG, an old man with a long pure white beard, seated on a chair looking at the jar with interest. No letters anywhere.
scenes.S32: Exactly two people: DALSOE stepping forward calmly from a crowd under moonlight, EOKSUN holding his hand beside him.
scenes.S34: Only one person in the picture: DALSOE speaking calmly and clearly with one hand raised toward something off-screen, moonlight on his face.
scenes.S35: [WEB] Close-up at night: JEONG leaning over and holding a small lantern to look inside the wide mouth of a large white jar; inside, a clear horizontal seam line around the middle with finger marks pressed into the clay. Nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S36: Only one person in the picture: HWANG in a green official robe stepping backward with a pale white face, trembling hands, sweat on his forehead, in a moonlit kiln yard with lanterns. Plain background, no letters, no calligraphy anywhere.
scenes.S37: Only one person in the picture: EOKSUN standing on tiptoe, pointing into a large white jar and shouting excitedly under moonlight.
scenes.S38: [WEB] Scene at a kiln yard under a full moon: 1. SEATED: JEONG, stern. 2. KNEELING before him with forehead to the ground: HWANG. 3. BACKGROUND: DALSOE and EOKSUN standing beside the large round white jar.
scenes.S39: [SIL] Night sky with a huge full moon among layered silver clouds, below it one large round white moon jar glowing softly on a platform, silhouettes of officials around it in awe.
scenes.S40: Exactly two people under moonlight in a kiln yard: JEONG and DALSOE bowing politely to each other with warm smiles, a large round white jar between them. Nothing in their hands.
scenes.S41: [SIL] Pale dawn sky, a lone small man in a long official robe without his hat walking away down an empty dirt road from a kiln yard, head bowed, long shadow.
scenes.S42: A thatched village yard in daylight: villagers cheering as DALSOE sets a large round white jar back down in the center, EOKSUN hugging it happily.
scenes.S43: A bright kiln workshop: DALSOE, the only adult, teaching several young apprentice boys how to join two big white clay bowls into one jar, everyone smiling, many round white jars on shelves.
scenes.S44: [SIL] Full moon over a thatched village, in every yard a round white jar glowing softly in the moonlight, silhouettes of families sitting together.
